verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal runs online filing and registration services, and a government digital service could plausibly publish its source code, so the openness axis applies. The evidence pack has no mention of a source repository or an open-source license for the portal. The only 'licença' reference (docs-25) is about recording industrial-property licences, not a software license, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
